reconcile.note: Clarke reads 'first to rise' as first to rise immortal and never die again, distinct from the temporary revivals of Lazarus and others before him.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogs the witch's raising of Samuel and the earlier raisings by Elijah, Elisha, and Jesus himself as resurrections that predate Christ.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013).

sides.snippet: An old man comes up…Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he bowed with his face to the ground, and did obeisance.
sides.verseText: He said to her, What form is he of? She said, An old man comes up; and he is covered with a robe. Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he bowed with his face to the ground, and did obeisance.

sides.snippet: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruits of those who are asleep.
sides.verseText: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruits of those who are asleep.
